versions.changelog: v1.1.0: Implemented Telegram Bot API delivery directly in monitor.py (--telegram-token + --chat-id flags on setup). Fixed SKILL.md to accurately describe alert delivery. Removed inconsistent curl references from INSTRUCTIONS.md. API path verified against live DexScreener v1 endpoint.
Initial release — monitor any Solana token 24/7 via DexScreener. Price alerts, volume spikes, liquidity drops, whale detection, market cap milestones. No API key required.
